description: This file defines a BrowserSession class for managing browser automation using Puppeteer within a VSCode extension. It includes methods for launching, connecting, navigating, interacting, and taking screenshots in browser sessions, supporting both local and remote browsers.

classes.name: BrowserSession
classes.description: A class managing browser automation sessions, supporting local and remote browsers, with methods for navigation, interaction, screenshots, and session management.

methods.name: ensureChromiumExists
methods.description: Ensures Chromium is installed, downloading if necessary, and returns its path.

methods.name: getViewport
methods.description: Retrieves the viewport size from global state or defaults.

methods.name: launchLocalBrowser
methods.description: Launches a local Chromium browser instance.

methods.name: connectWithChromeHostUrl
methods.description: Connects to a remote browser via WebSocket URL.

methods.name: connectToRemoteBrowser
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a remote browser using cached or provided URLs, or auto-discovery.

methods.name: launchBrowser
methods.description: Main method to launch either local or remote browser based on settings.

methods.name: closeBrowser
methods.description: Closes the active browser session and resets state.

methods.name: resetBrowserState
methods.description: Resets internal browser state variables.

methods.name: doAction
methods.description: Performs actions on the current page, handling logs, errors, and screenshots.

methods.name: getRootDomain
methods.description: Extracts root domain from a URL.

methods.name: navigatePageToUrl
methods.description: Navigates a page to a specified URL with waiting for load.

methods.name: createNewTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab and navigates to a URL.

methods.name: navigateToUrl
methods.description: Navigates to a URL, reusing existing tabs if possible.

methods.name: waitTillHTMLStable
methods.description: Waits until page HTML content stabilizes.

methods.name: forceLinksToSameTab
methods.description: Overrides link behaviors to stay in the same tab.

methods.name: handleMouseInteraction
methods.description: Handles mouse actions with network activity monitoring.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Performs a click at specified coordinates.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the page.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates key presses, including modifiers.

methods.name: scrollPage
methods.description: Scrolls the page up or down.

methods.name: scrollDown
methods.description: Scrolls the page down.

methods.name: scrollUp
methods.description: Scrolls the page up.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Moves mouse to hover over specified coordinates.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the browser viewport.

methods.name: getImageTypeFromPath
methods.description: Determines image type based on file extension.

methods.name: saveScreenshot
methods.description: Saves a screenshot to a specified path, validating path security.

methods.name: drawCursorIndicator
methods.description: Draws a visual cursor indicator on the page.

methods.name: removeCursorIndicator
methods.description: Removes the cursor indicator from the page.

methods.name: isSessionActive
methods.description: Checks if a browser session is active.

methods.name: getViewportSize
methods.description: Returns the last known or current viewport size.
